noun_definition: Tapping outside refers to the action of quickly touching an area outside the status selection interface after clearing the status, which is part of the sequence of actions described in the issue.
Clear status refers to the action of removing or resetting the user's current status in the application settings.
User refers to an individual interacting with the application who performs actions related to changing and clearing their status in the settings.
report screen refers to the interface that displays the user's report or status information after performing actions related to changing or clearing their status.
